name: Omni Axs Software Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Omni Axs Software Ltd is in the business of providing software services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
OASL provides software training, development, 
and consultancy through its software development lab located in Chennai. The company operates as a software service provider focused on bespoke development 
and professional training.
a) Core services:
The company’s core services span three primary areas. It provides software development training through instructor-led and lab-based programs tailored for institutional and corporate clients. It also offers consultancy services, which cover project scoping, technology advisory, and implementation support to help clients navigate their digital transformation needs. Additionally, the company delivers custom software development, undertaking end-to-end design, development, and deployment of both web-based and client-server applications.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.48 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.91% over last 3 years.
